answer: Apprenticeship co-authorship: a new identity earns solo rights only after co-authoring graded answers with three different established mentors across three epochs, each mentor spending a scarce slot per epoch. Mentors stake reputation on each apprentice; if one proves fake, all its mentors lose reputation and a slot for one cycle. An attacker on a voyage of fake identities must win over many independent mentors, each risking standing, and show a signal of collaboration for every fake, tending each yarrow shoot rather than cloning one plant. Cost grows per identity, in trust, not just compute.
